We need to rate each trait differential according to Moral Foundations Theory. Let's go through each one.

326: jealous :: opinionated
- jealous: could relate to fairness (jealousy over unequal treatment) or loyalty (jealousy in relationships). Opinionated: not strongly moral. Possibly fairness (feeling of unfairness). But jealous can also be general vice. I'll mark fairness=1 because jealousy often involves perceived unfairness. Also maybe loyalty=1 if in relationship context. But careful: not too broad. I'll set fairness=1, others 0. Notes: "jealousy relates to fairness (perceived inequity)".

327: protagonist :: antagonist
- These are narrative roles, not directly moral foundations. But antagonist could be seen as opposing or harming. Protagonist could be seen as good. General moral? Possibly general=1 for moral character roles. But not strong. I'll set general=1, notes: "protagonist/antagonist as moral archetypes".

328: devoted :: unfaithful
- Devoted: loyalty (loyalty virtue). Unfaithful: betrayal (loyalty vice). Clearly loyalty. Also unfaithful could relate to authority (disrespect) or purity (infidelity as impurity). But strongest is loyalty. Set loyalty=1. Possibly also care? Devoted to caring? But primary loyalty. Notes: "devoted and unfaithful directly relate to loyalty".

329: fearmongering :: reassuring
- Fearmongering: causing fear, could be harm (care vice)? Reassuring: comforting, care virtue. So care=1. Also authority? Fearmongering can be about control. But mainly care. Set care=1.

330: common sense :: analysis
- These are cognitive styles, not moral. Probably no relation. All 0.

331: unemotional :: emotional
- Not directly moral. Could be related to purity? Emotional as less controlled? Or care? Not strong. All 0.

332: rap :: rock
- Music genres, no moral content. All 0.

333: genocidal :: not genocidal
- Genocidal is extreme harm (care vice). Not genocidal is neutral. So care=1. Also general moral? Genocidal is evil. But care covers harm. Set care=1.

334: cat person :: dog person
- No moral content. All 0.

335: indie :: pop
- Music genres, no moral. All 0.

336: cultured :: rustic
- Could relate to purity? Cultured as refined, rustic as natural. But not strong. Possibly no. All 0.

337: tautology :: oxymoron
- Linguistic terms, no moral. All 0.

338: bad boy :: white knight
- Bad boy: rebellious, maybe authority vice (defiance). White knight: rescuer, care virtue. Also loyalty? White knight might be loyal. But bad boy can be seen as liberty (resisting authority). I'll set authority=1 for bad boy (defying authority) and care=1 for white knight (helping). Also maybe general. But we rate overall. Since either pole can trigger, set care=1 (white knight helps) and authority=1 (bad boy defies). Notes: "white knight relates to care, bad boy to authority defiance".

339: princess :: queen
- Royal roles, could relate to authority (hierarchy). But neutral. Possibly authority=1? Or not. I'll set authority=1 for both as positions of authority. Notes: "royal titles relate to authority".

340: hypochondriac :: stoic
- Hypochondriac: excessive worry about health, not directly moral. Stoic: endurance, self-control. Could relate to purity (self-discipline) or care? Stoic might be seen as not caring? Not strong. All 0.

341: yes-man :: contrarian
- Yes-man: obsequious, authority virtue? Yes-man obeys authority. Contrarian: opposes, authority vice. So authority=1. Also loyalty? Yes-man loyal to group? But more authority. Set authority=1. Notes: "yes-man complies with authority, contrarian defies".

342: giving :: receiving
- Giving: care virtue (generosity). Receiving: neutral. So care=1. Also fairness? Giving can be fair. But care is primary. Set care=1.

343: chic :: cheesy
- Aesthetic judgments, not moral. All 0.

344: celebrity :: boy/girl-next-door
- Celebrity: status, authority? Boy/girl-next-door: ordinary. Possibly authority (celebrity as high status). But not strong moral. All 0.

345: goth :: flower child
- Subcultures. Goth: dark, might be purity vice? Flower child: peace, care. Could be care=1 for flower child (peace). But not strong. I'll set care=1 for flower child's association with peace and love. Notes: "flower child relates to care (peace, love)".

346: summer :: winter
- Seasons, no moral. All 0.

347: frank :: sugarcoated
- Frank: honest, could be fairness (honesty). Sugarcoated: dishonest, unfair. So fairness=1. Also general honesty. Set fairness=1.

348: naive :: paranoid
- Naive: trusting, possibly vulnerable. Paranoid: distrustful. Not directly moral. Could be related to care? Paranoid might see harm everywhere. But not strong. All 0.

349: gullible :: cynical
- Gullible: easily deceived, cynical: distrusting. Similar to 348. Not strongly moral. Possibly fairness? Deception? But no. All 0.

350: motivated :: unmotivated
- Motivation is not moral. Could be related to purity (self-discipline) but not strong. All 0.
